title: Saturday at the Shelter
passage:
Every Saturday morning, a small group of people gathers at the animal shelter on the edge of town. They are not staff. They are {{1}}, and they come to walk dogs, clean cages, and spend time with cats that have been waiting a long time for a home.

Most of them started with a simple wish to help, and discovered that the work {{2}} more than it takes. Dogs that are walked regularly become {{3}} and easier to adopt. Cats that are touched every day learn to trust people again. A helper who arrives feeling tired often leaves feeling {{4}}, because the animals do not care about the problems waiting at home.

The shelter's manager says the helpers are {{5}} to its survival. The budget covers food and medical care, but there is never enough money for extra staff. Without people who {{6}} their free time, many animals would spend whole days alone.

Volunteering is not always {{7}}. Some animals are frightened, some are sick, and a few cannot be adopted at all. New helpers are trained to {{8}} the rules: wash your hands, watch your fingers, and never open a cage without asking. It can be {{9}} at first, but most people find the routine satisfying.

The shelter also asks its helpers to {{10}} the message that an animal is a long-term responsibility. A puppy given as a gift may be abandoned by winter. If more people understood that, fewer dogs would be waiting on a Saturday morning.

blanks.explain: They are not staff. They are volunteers 指他们不是员工而是“志愿者”，需要复数名词。
the work gives more than it takes 指这份工作“给予”的比索取的多，主语 the work 决定用第三人称单数。
dogs become calmer 指被经常遛的狗变得更“平静”，也更容易被领养；wooden、annual 不合。
leaves feeling cheerful 指离开时感到“愉快”，与 arrives feeling tired 形成对比。
volunteers are essential to its survival 指志愿者对收容所的存续“必不可少”，后文说明人手不足。
people who donate their free time 指“捐出”业余时间的人，与志愿工作的性质吻合。
not always pleasant 指志愿工作并不总是“愉快的”，后面列举了害怕、生病的动物。
trained to follow the rules 指接受培训以“遵守”规则，冒号后正是具体规定。
it can be confusing at first 指一开始可能“令人困惑”，与后文 most people find the routine satisfying 转折。
spread the message 指“传播”这一信息，即养宠物是长期责任；postpone、punish 不合。
